title: Lambda Functions
description: Use anonymous functions for short operations.
context: Common in data transformations and functional programming patterns.
codeSnippet:
add = lambda a, b: a + b

print(add(2, 3))

title: Map Function
description: Apply a function to all elements in an iterable.
codeSnippet:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4]

result = list(map(lambda x: x * 2, numbers))

print(result)

title: Filter Function
description: Filter elements from a list based on a condition.
context: Used for data cleaning and filtering pipelines.
technicalNotes: Keeps elements that evaluate to True
codeSnippet:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

even = list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, numbers))

print(even)

context: Used in backend systems and data processing pipelines.
codeSnippet:

with open('file.txt', 'r') as f:

print(content)
